Thanks, Mina / Anika — I reviewed the redline and procurement packet. Summary of proposed commercial responses below and attached a markup (redline-comments.xlsx):

1) Invoice recipient entity
- Proposed clause: Redwood will issue invoices to the billing entity specified in the Order Form. If Customer requests a remit-to different entity, Customer must provide a valid PO and EFT routing; Redwood reserves the right to issue tax documentation (1099/173) to the entity that receives payment.
- Action: Anika / Priya — please confirm the US entity legal name, EIN, and preferred remit-to address/format.

2) Net terms
- Our standard is Net 30. To accept Net 45 on the committed tranche we propose: a) Net 45 for committed amounts only, b) a 1.0% discount if payment is received within 30 days, and c) Redwood may apply a holdback equal to 10% of the final monthly invoice during the first 6 months (release after month 6 subject to payment history).
- This balances cashflow while accommodating procurement.

3) Tax / withholding clause
- Proposed drafting: Customer is responsible for withholding taxes imposed by Customer's jurisdiction; Customer will provide Redwood with valid tax exemption certificates or VAT/GST documentation where applicable. Redwood will cooperate to supply necessary tax forms.

4) Minimum commit ramp
- Proposed schedule: 50% of committed ARR for months 1–3; 75% months 4–6; 100% thereafter. We'll include a one-time true-up at month 6.

I attached the redline-comments.xlsx with inline suggestions and a proposed alternate language block for Net 45. Kimberly — flag legal risks / alternate language you want to use.
